thread:
tara: Quick sync — finalizing the social cadence for the webinar + benchmark release. Draft schedule below, need final copy, hero image, 30s clip, and GTM routing. Can everyone review?

sam: On it. Is the CTA 'Register' -> landing page with benchmark download after the webinar?

tara: Yep. Primary CTA: Register. Secondary: download benchmark (gated) post-event. Landing: https://redwood.ai/webinar-march (use UTMs).

maria: For paid, suggest 2x flight windows: 48h before live and day-of 3h push. Retarget people who click but don't register. Audience: product managers + infra leads. Budget request coming. :money_with_wings:

leo: Routing note — all webinar signups should create an inbound lead in the SDR queue with tags: webinar_march, benchmark. Please ensure we capture referral (social channel + utm_content). I can add a Zap or webhook.

sam: Draft post copy options (short for X, longer for LinkedIn). Feedback welcome.

sam: Variant A (X):
"New research: production LLM inference costs vs latency — live webinar w/ benchmarks. Join us Wed 3/24 — register: https://redwood.ai/webinar-march?utm_source=x&utm_campaign=webinar_march&utm_medium=social&utm_content=variant_a #LLM #MLOps"

sam: Variant B (X):
"How do teams cut inference costs without sacrificing latency? We tested models & infra. Demo + benchmarks in our webinar — register: https://redwood.ai/webinar-march?utm_source=x&utm_campaign=webinar_march&utm_medium=social&utm_content=variant_b"

sam: LinkedIn long form (post):
"We ran a production benchmark comparing inference strategies across latency and cost. Join our engineers for a live walkthrough and actionable recommendations. Register here → https://redwood.ai/webinar-march?utm_source=linkedin&utm_campaign=webinar_march&utm_medium=social&utm_content=longform
Highlights: benchmark overview, deployment patterns, cost-saving knobs, live Q&A."

maria: Love the copy. For X we should test emojis + no-emoji. Also want a pinned comment with the registration link in the thread.

tara: Assets needed: hero static (1200x675), 30s clip (mp4, 1920x1080), 3 GIFs for story amplification, and speaker headshots. Can design deliver by Wed EOD? @maria will coordinate paid.

leo: For routing — here's the webhook payload we need from the form:
```json
{
  "email": "...",
  "name": "...",
  "source": "social",
  "channel": "{{utm_source}}",
  "utm_content": "{{utm_content}}",
  "tags": ["webinar_march", "benchmark"]
}
```

leo: If we can't get the webhook ready, fallback is CSV export every 2 hours to the SDR queue.

sam: Small ask — can we include a 1-line teaser for a follow-up benchmark blog (to drive downloads)? e.g., 'Stay after the demo for a deep-dive blog + reproducible notebook.'

maria: Paid creative ask: need 3 copy variants + 2 CTAs (Register / Learn more). Will send asset spec and audience lists today.

engage-bot: Reminder: scheduled posts draft saved in Hootsuite workspace 'Redwood Marketing' at 2026-03-18T09:00Z.

tara: Final gating/questions: 1) final copy by Tue noon, 2) assets by Wed EOD, 3) routing test done by Thu morning. Can everyone ack?

sam: Ack — copy by Tue noon.

maria: Ack — will coordinate creative & paid.

leo: Ack — I'll set up webhook + test flow, aim Thu 08:00.

tara: Great — thanks team. I'll compile and send the scheduling grid and tag mapping after lunch. :rocket:
